verdict.rationale: The pack documents a Model Improvement privacy setting and incognito chats that are excluded from model training (claude-docs-46, claude-docs-47). That controls whether chats train models, which is a related but different switch from telemetry or usage-tracking opt-out. No evidence shows a documented control to disable telemetry, analytics or usage tracking in Claude.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
